text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I was invited to a party celebrating the
racing success of the young Umamusume that
Cesario often watches over.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
Big sis Cesario, look, look~!
Ehehe, pretty dress, right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just like a princess!
You did your best in the kids' race, after all.
...Today, everyone's the star.
choice_data_list: You look deeply moved.
You seem somehow deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, without a doubt.
I've seen everyone's hard work up close, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"So, I thought I'd celebrate
with everything I've got today♪"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, here you go.
Be careful not to drop the food, okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B
text_block_list.text:
Wah, dried fruit cake~!
Ehehe, I'm gonna share it with everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, seeing them so happy...
All that studying of recipes was worth it.
choice_data_list: Did you make this dish just now?
Did you make this dish just now?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes, actually. I remembered you telling me you liked it when we had lunch together.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything I could do, I just wanted to help.
...You really gave it your all in that race.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C
text_block_list.text:
C-Cesario-san!
U-Um... I won a medal...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ! You're...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...That was truly a magnificent performance.
Your daily training has truly borne fruit."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes. ...It's because Cesario-san
gave me such strict guidance..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C
text_block_list.text:
Even inside the gate, I didn't get nervous...
and I was able to run with all my might...!
choice_data_list: (Speaking of the starting gate...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Easing tension by establishing a routine for entering the gate... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
This might be effective for that girl.
First, I should make a proposal to the teacher—
choice_data_list: (So that was to coach the kids...?)
(So that was to coach the kids...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, truly.
...You've always been so dedicated to your training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's about that time.
...Trainer, please excuse me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I'm giving a congratulatory speech to the children
after this, so I'm going to go change
into something suitable."
choice_data_list: By changing, you mean into a dress or something?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha, well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...This is it.
choice_data_list: To think this is the Muse's racing outfit...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As I thought, this stands out a bit too much... doesn't it?
Even though the children are supposed to be the stars of today.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's a request from everyone.
They said, 'If you're going to praise us, we want
you to wear that princess-like outfit.'”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Then I'd gladly wear any costume at all♪
...If it brings a smile to those children's faces, that is.
choice_data_list: (...They really care about their students, don't they?)
(...They really care about their students, don't they?)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!
Amazing, amazing, it's so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
Now then, allow me to offer some celebratory words to everyone—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hold on a sec!
...Everyone, on three...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis Cesario,
thank you so much as always!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? E-Everyone...?
choice_data_list: W-What does that mean...?
W-What does that mean...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yay!
Surprise successful~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even a bouquet like this...
But, what do you mean by a surprise...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone... just wanted to say thank you.
The only reason we were able to shine...
is all thanks to you, Cesario-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...You're exaggerating.
I merely assisted with the coaching, that's all."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Big Sis is... our teacher!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
Big sis is always so kind.
She's always looking out for us, and—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you're always so cool!
And you taught me so many important things!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: "The reason we can run around so much now is all thanks to Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
"That's why... I wanted you
to wear that sparkling outfit."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
You're the star of this party too,
big sis!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Everyone...
choice_data_list: ...I'm really glad to hear that.
...I'm really glad for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Someday, she swore an oath upon her racewear. To become a foundation that passes down the achievements forged by her predecessors to the children of the future—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now, surrounded by so many children,
she receives their blessings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer...
no sight could possibly be more moving than this."
choice_data_list: Congratulations, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Right now... I'm just so happy!
choice_data_list: Let's fulfill our vow together with that racing outfit!
Everyone is looking forward to your guidance.
Everyone is looking forward to your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Right now... I'm just so happy!
choice_data_list: Let's fulfill our vow together with that racing outfit!
Everyone is looking forward to your guidance.
Everyone is looking forward to your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I am still only halfway along the path.
I cannot afford to come to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I shall continue on my path...
To become a leader worthy of the love of her beloved children.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I would be more than happy to, if you'll have me.
I am ready to instruct you anytime.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: For the sake of your brilliant futures.
